about: 34-year-old retail manager considering a move into software.

items.text: Store Manager at RetailCo, September 2019 to present. Manages a team of 22, owns the store schedule and inventory budget.
Earlier: Assistant Manager at RetailCo 2016 to 2019, Sales Associate 2013 to 2016.
Education: Diploma in Business Administration, Seneca College, 2013.
Recent post: 'Fourteen years in retail. Starting to learn to code in the evenings.'
Four public repositories, all tutorial projects in HTML, CSS and JavaScript, 9 commits in total, all since May 2026.
A repository named 'inventory-tool' with a small JavaScript script that reads a spreadsheet of stock counts.
Asked ChatGPT how much full-time coding bootcamps cost and whether part-time evening programs are worth it.
Asked ChatGPT what junior developer salaries look like compared with retail management pay.
Asked ChatGPT how to learn JavaScript while working full-time with an irregular schedule.
Asked ChatGPT how long a career switch into software usually takes and whether employers hire people without a computer science degree.
Photos at the park with two young children, caption: 'family Saturday'.
Post of a finished home-built bookshelf, caption: 'learned this from videos, took three weekends'.
